newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SOCCER-DAHLIN SAYS TO SIGN FOR BLACKBURN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DAHLIN SAYS TO SIGN FOR BLACKBURN.

text.p: Swedish striker Martin Dahlin said on Tuesday he was joining English premier league club Blackburn Rovers for a fee of around three million pounds ($5.08 million).
Dahlin, who has made 55 international appearances for Sweden, said his Italian club Roma had agreed terms with Blackburn and he had decided to join the English club.

"It feels good that everything is ready. It feels good to be playing for Roy Hodgson again and it feels good to be going to the (English) premier league. That's where everyone wants to be playing just now," Dahlin said.
Dahlin moved to Roma last year from Borussia Moenchengladbach but was unable to secure a first team berth and returned on loan to the German club.
The 29-year-old striker will train with his new club when Blackburn visit Sweden for two pre-season friendlies later his week.
Blackburn manager Roy Hodgson knows Dahlin well. Dahlin was nurtured by Hodgson as a youngster with Swedish first division Malmo, where the Englishman was manager.
